name.title: Wallet Name
name.caption: Give your wallet a name you'll recognize.

account.title: Number of accounts
account.caption: Tell us how many accounts you want to create.
account.description: A wallet in $t(common:appName) can have up to {{accountLimit}} accounts. You can delegate each account to a different stake pool. Your account keys come from the wallet root key.
account.tooltip: Each account you add increases the sync time, but you can always add more accounts later.

create.title: Creating your wallet
create.caption: Please wait while your wallet is being made.

password.title: Set your spending password
password.caption: Pick a long password. The longer it is, the safer your funds will be.

status.exists: Looks like that Wallet already exists! We're taking you there now.
